newsitem.title: USA: DuPont's Conoco to triple isobutane output.
newsitem.headline: DuPont's Conoco to triple isobutane output.

text.p: - Conoco, a unit of DuPont Co, said Tuesday it plans to triple isobutane production to 6,000 barrels per day at its Wingate Fractionator facility in northwest New Mexico.
Conoco also said it will upgrade the facility to simplify operations, reduce maintenance costs, and improve efficiencies.

The increased production capacity will come from construction of a new butane isomerization unit, or butamer, it said. The new butamer unit is scheduled to come onstream in the second quarter of 1998.

"Increasing Wingate's isobutane capacity and upgrading the facility will help establish Conoco as a preferred supplier to refineries in the southwestern U.S. and California," said Michael L. Johnson, vice president natural gas and gas products. "This is a continuation of Conoco's strategy to maximize the value of the raw materials we process."

The Wingate facility was acquired by Conoco in 1996. Project engineering and procurement for the butamer have already started. Field construction is scheduled to begin within the next two to three months.
